title: Greeting Route
description: Implement an Express route that accepts a name query parameter and returns a JSON greeting.
hints: Validate the name query parameter before building the response.
io_contract: GET /greeting?name={name} returns 200 OK with JSON {"message":"Hello, <name>!"} when name is non-blank. A missing or blank name returns 400 Bad Request with JSON {"error":"name is required"}. Unknown query parameters are ignored.
ambiguity_resolutions: A missing name returns 400 Bad Request.
A blank name returns 400 Bad Request.
The success response uses the JSON field "message".
The error response uses the JSON field "error".
The greeting includes the submitted name without trimming.
The response content type is application/json.
